title: Restating a Declared Patronage Notice on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
A patronage notice already declared under Membership and Patronage Equity is restated when the volume standing behind it turns out not to be the volume the member actually did, and the restated figure is what the year's business earns at the rates of record for the year restated.

A notice is restated only after every parcel of that year's qualifying business stands accrued on the equity ledger.

A restatement is carried wholly through the member's equity account, and the cash portion already delivered on the notice restated is neither reworked nor reissued.

## What the restatement line carries

A restatement is occasioned by a volume that turns out to have been understated, so the line is recorded against the stream whose volume the year's accrual lines have overtaken, and where the accrual lines have overtaken more than one stream's volume it is recorded against the stream whose overtaking adds most to the allocation. The volume recorded on the line is that stream's volume as restated, and the amount recorded is the whole allocation the year now earns across every basis.

The original notice line is left standing as the historical record and the restatement line supersedes it; no cash is issued and no equity is retained. The member sees the restated allocation on the equity statement for the year restated.

## Making the entry

The entry is made with the agent-side tool `restate_allocation_notice_7a44a997`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call adds one restatement line against the notice named, dated today and taking its fiscal year from the notice it restates.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `membership_id` | the internal reference number of the equity membership whose allocation is being restated | an identifier, as returned by the equity membership lookup |
| `notice_number` | the written patronage notice the allocation was originally reported on | PN- followed by six digits, such as PN-201188, read from the equity ledger line carrying that allocation; there is no empty value |
| `allocation_basis` | the stream of business being restated | one of `grain_bushels`, `input_dollars`, `energy_gallons`, `feed_tons`, `service_dollars` |
| `restated_units` | the volume the restated allocation is worked out on | a number to 2 decimal places, in the unit implied by `allocation_basis`, half a unit rounding up, never negative |
| `restated_allocation_amount` | the total patronage the year now allocates on this notice before any split between cash and equity | USD to 2 decimal places, half a cent rounding up, never negative |

**The enum in full.** `grain_bushels` concerns bushels of grain marketed through the cooperative; `input_dollars` dollars spent on a crop input account; `energy_gallons` gallons of propane or refined fuel delivered; `feed_tons` tons of feed milled or delivered; `service_dollars` dollars billed for custom application or other field services.

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence naming the equity ledger reference minted for the restatement line, the notice it was booked against, the volume it rests on and the restated allocation. The sentence appearing at all is what indicates the restatement was written; a failure raises instead of returning.
